name: current control with a controlled voltage source
description: A PI controller holds the current of R = 1 ohm and L = 10 mH at its reference, which steps from 0 to 1 A at 5 ms. With Kp = L wc and Ki = R wc (wc = 500 rad/s) the zero of the controller cancels the pole of the circuit, and the current would follow 1 - exp(-wc t) if the controller acted at once. The controlled source follows its signal one time step late (0.1 ms), which shows as a small overshoot of the voltage command.
